messages.text:
Your bedding order includes a wool blanket that our return records don’t show as received, so I can’t request a refund for the whole order yet. The other two items are recorded as received back. We can request refunds for those, and the blanket can be included once it arrives. [refund-policy/v2/return]

Would you like a refund for the two items already received, or have you already sent the blanket?
